description: Get aggregate audience composition for a project — totals plus status, rating, rep and language breakdowns. Use for a quick shape-of-the-list answer. Not paginated: totals and the status and rating breakdowns cover every member, but the language list is truncated to the top 20 and the rep and custom-dimension lists to the top 25, and the rep block is absent unless the project maps an owner merge field. For Mailchimp-list health — per-audience sizes, unsubscribe and cleaned counts, open and click rates — use the list overview in sm_get_insights_basic; this tool is the member-composition view (status, rating, rep, language) instead.

projectId.description: Required. The opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters to scope this request to. Call GET /_api/public/v1/enterprise/projects to list the project IDs available to your API key. Omitting it returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

name: sm_get_member_overview

outputSchema.description: Output for the sm_get_member_overview tool. Failure payloads arrive in the same envelope as { error, code }.

slot.description: Dimension slot name, for example dimensionOne.

unassignedLabel.description: Label shown for members with no value in the slot.

values.description: Distinct dimension values with member counts.

items.description: A single distinct dimension value and its member count.

error.description: A human-readable error message detailing what went wrong.

items.description: Count of members grouped by reported language.

projectId.description: An opaque alphanumeric project identifier of 8 or more characters identifying a Space Monkey Project. Treat this value as entirely opaque; do not parse, sequentialize, or auto-generate it.
